title: Why Undead
html: Undead comes out on top because of Touch of the Grave: your attacks sometimes drain the boss and heal you, at most once every 15 seconds. The racial's tooltip says "up to" 5% of your health, but the drain itself says "equal to" 5%, so we count the full 5%. We haven't seen it in a combat log yet: if it heals for less in game, the gap to the other races shrinks, and another race may be as good.

title: Fears
html: Magmadar's Panic and Onyxia's Bellowing Roar aren't in the fights, so Will of the Forsaken, and Berserker Rage in Berserker Stance, aren't worth anything here. In the raid logs we have, every one of those fears met an immunity, as raids plan for: Fear Ward, Tremor Totem or your own Berserker Rage. Without them, a fear costs you seconds of threat and can let the boss loose, and Undead's Will of the Forsaken covers one fear every 2 minutes on top of Berserker Rage. We can't put a fair number on that, so the race tables leave it out.

title: Racial buttons
html: Blood Fury, Berserking, Elune's Light and Eureka! are used on cooldown from the pull. Waiting for the end of the fight or a few seconds in always scored lower: early threat is what lets your DPS start. Stoneform is different: it costs a global cooldown and some Rage from the hits it softens, so Balanced and Max survival use it on cooldown from 20 seconds in, after your opening, and Max threat skips it. In game, save it for a big hit or a bleed if you can.

title: Low-health buttons
html: The sim doesn't wait for you to get low. Shield Wall is used near the end of the fight, and Last Stand and health potions aren't used at all. In game, use them when you need them: that's on top of what's shown here.

title: No bubbles
html: Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Lay on Hands aren't used: a tank under a bubble loses the boss to someone else. Templar's Bulwark is used on cooldown instead, and it shares Forbearance with them.

title: Bear Form threat
html: Bear Form's threat bonus follows Blizzard's patch notes (+115%), not the older tooltip (+50%). If the notes are wrong in game, bears make a lot less threat than shown here.

title: Furor
html: Furor's Rage is wasted when you shift into Bear Form before the pull, so none of the setups take it.

title: Max threat and Balanced
html: These two are the same setup in practice: they only differ in when Maul is queued.

title: Earth Shock threat
html: Earth Shock counts as twice its damage in threat, as in Classic. Forever's tooltip only says it causes "a high amount of threat". If it's less in game, the Warden loses most of its lead in Safe DPS.

title: More damage taken
html: The Warden has no plate and no Shield Block, so it takes more damage than the other tanks and needs the most healing. Its threat comes early instead: Earth Shock with a full mana bar, Stormstrike and totems before the pull.
